full_name: Alison C. Rollins | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2023–2024 Fiction & Poetry Mary I. Bunting Institute Fellow Independent Writer
bio: Alison C. Rollins draws from various literary and art-making practices—including sonics, sculpture, metalwork, and video—in attempts to ethically engage in resuscitation of the archive, and her work celebrates the Black American experience and the ways in which cataloging, technology, and identities are inextricably entangled.
